subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should OpenClaw solve stranded `message_tool_only` substantive finals with this default-off `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` option, with the default-on replacement policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99536 after it is refreshed, or with warning-only behavior?
rationale: The code path sits on a documented privacy/message-delivery contract, and both candidate PRs encode different product policies; automation cannot choose the permanent user-facing default or privacy stance.

options.title: Keep this opt-in recovery path
options.body: Require real external-transport proof, then land this PR if maintainers want recovery available only when operators explicitly enable `messages.strandedReplyRecovery`.

options.title: Prefer the refreshed replacement
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99536 to become clean and re-proven, then close this PR as superseded if maintainers want default-on recovery and sanitized diagnostic fallback.

options.title: Keep warning-only behavior
options.body: Reject both recovery branches if maintainers decide that `message_tool_only` should never retry or surface any recovery behavior beyond diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Keep this opt-in recovery path
recommendation.body: Require real external-transport proof, then land this PR if maintainers want recovery available only when operators explicitly enable `messages.strandedReplyRecovery`.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle merged and rewrote the warning-only baseline and is the strongest available ownership signal for the privacy/product policy decision.
